subject: Implementation staging & training MAP — proposed canary and migration windows
thread_body:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@orionhealth.com>, Tech Team <tech@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Implementation staging & training MAP — proposed canary and migration windows

Hi Jamie / Orion engineering,

Thanks again for signing — excited to get the rollout moving. Attached is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that folds the post-signature implementation deliverables into the evaluation plan you asked for. High-level ask: can you confirm the canary cohort (two internal apps + one external partner) and the target migration weekend preference (Sat 2026-07-10)?

Attachments: Orion_MAP_v1.2.pdf (MAP with timeline), Orion_EvalPlan_Q3.xlsx (eval matrix), SOW_Orion_Redwood_v1.docx

Proposed next steps (from our side):
- Week 0 (now): Finalize MAP and acceptance criteria for eval (pass/fail thresholds in eval spreadsheet).
- Week 2: Canary deploy to staging with telemetry hooks + smoke tests.
- Week 4: Canary in production with 5% traffic by route, automated rollback on error budget triggers.
- Week 6: Full migration of pinned routes, training sessions for ops & support.

Training plan (outline): two 60-min sessions (Ops runbook + Troubleshooting/Playbooks), plus one hands-on 2-hour migration dress rehearsal for SRE. We’ll deliver runbook drafts 4 business days prior.

Canary acceptance criteria (summary):
- 99th pctl latency within 1.5x baseline
- Error rate < 0.1% over 1 hour window
- No data egress beyond your VPC during canary traffic

Please flag any conflicts with your procurement or audit locks so we can shift windows.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

-----Original Message-----
From: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@orionhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tech Team <tech@orionhealth.com>, Procurement <procurements@orionhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Implementation staging & training MAP — proposed canary and migration windows

Rafael,

Appreciate the plan — looks thorough. A couple quick notes from Orion’s side:
- Canary cohort: want to include Patient Portal (internal) and Partner API (external partner Acme Labs) — that matches your two internal + one external ask.
- Migration weekend: Sat 2026-07-10 works but procurement has an internal approval freeze on the following week (7/12–7/16). If there are post-migration invoices, they’ll process after 7/20.
- Security: we need the KMS/HSM integration checklist filled out before canary. Can your team provide the HSM connectivity diagram?

I’ll loop in procurement for their read on billing.

—Jamie
Jamie Collins
Director, Platform Engineering | Orion Health
jamie.collins@orionhealth.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@orionhealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 12:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Implementation staging & training MAP — proposed canary and migration windows

Jamie — thanks, that cohort sounds right. I’m attaching the draft training slides and the Ops runbook timeline (see Orion_EvalPlan_Q3.xlsx for the training checklist). We will:
- Deliver Ops runbook draft by Mon 2026-06-21.
- Schedule two live sessions (Ops Runbook + Troubleshooting) on 2026-06-29 and 2026-07-01.
- Run the 2-hour dress rehearsal with SRE on 2026-07-07 (this is a non-production run using replay data).

On the HSM diagram: Rafael, Marcus can you confirm who owns the KMS integration artifact? Marcus, tagging you for the network diagram and required firewall rules.

Monica
Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
Attachment stubs: Training_Slides_v0.9.pdf (slides), Ops_Runbook_outline.md

-----Original Message-----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@orionhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:35:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Implementation staging & training MAP — proposed canary and migration windows

Folks — I’ve attached a minimal HSM connectivity diagram and a short firewall rules checklist. Key notes:
- We will use TLS mutual auth to the HSM gateway; customer-managed subnet required.
- Egress: only to your KMS endpoint (no external third-party egress).
- I’ll coordinate a brief network call on 2026-06-22 to validate routes.

Attachment stub: HSM_connectivity_diagram.svg
Marcus Lin
Lead Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

-----Original Message-----
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@orionhealth.com>, Procurement <procurements@orionhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Implementation staging & training MAP — proposed canary and migration windows

Thanks Marcus — that solves the HSM ask. Jamie / procurement — noted on the payment timing; we’ll mark the SOW milestone >30d for billing to accommodate your freeze and can still proceed with the technical cut. Monica and I will keep the canary at 5% traffic for the first 48 hours and automate rollback to the previous model on any deviation from the acceptance criteria.

Action items (owner / due):
- Marcus: Network call 2026-06-22 (confirm) — DONE
- Monica: Ops runbook draft 2026-06-21 — IN PROGRESS
- Rafael: Final MAP (incorporate HSM note) 2026-06-19 — IN PROGRESS
- Jamie / Procurement: Confirm any contract gating items by 2026-06-24

Rafael

-----Original Message-----
From: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@orionhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tech Team <tech@orionhealth.com>, Procurement <procurements@orionhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Implementation staging & training MAP — proposed canary and migration windows

Rafael / Monica — all good from my side. Procurement confirmed no additional gating items; they acknowledged the shifted invoice timing. We’re green to proceed with the dates below:
- Network validation call: 2026-06-22 (completed)
- Ops runbook draft review: 2026-06-21
- Training sessions: 2026-06-29 & 2026-07-01
- Dress rehearsal: 2026-07-07
- Canary production (5%): 2026-07-10 02:00–08:00 UTC
- Full migration window: 2026-07-17–2026-07-18

I’ll share a short post-migration verification checklist with the Tech Team on 7/18 morning. Thanks for the coordination.

—Jamie
